featured_reviews.name: Omkar J
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting Wellness Forever was an utterly disappointing and frustrating experience. I went to buy a simple pediatric cough syrup, carrying a partial photo of a valid prescription, expecting a reasonable approach. Despite clearly showing the medicine wasn’t a restricted “red tag” drug, the staff bluntly refused to sell, sticking rigidly to their own rules and showing zero empathy or understanding for the situation. When I offered to immediately share the full prescription photo, the answer was a flat “NO”, delivered with rudeness and no sense of customer service at all.

If this shop wants to be so “professional” about regulations, I suggest they first look seriously into their hygiene and basic standards. The store was far from clean and didn’t seem to follow common precautions one would expect from a reputed pharmacy. Even more infuriating, their advertised “24x7 home delivery” is just a sham, the staff conveniently refuse deliveries after 10pm, citing fear of street dogs as a reason, which is frankly laughable. Why aggressively highlight round-the-clock service and home delivery if you don’t intend to fulfill it?

After repeated requests and unhelpful staff, I walked out and decided never to return. Just next door, a small non-branded local shop was polite, respectful, and much more helpful. The staff there do not show any of the arrogance and poor attitude seen at Wellness Forever; clearly, being a big brand has led to a lack of basic courtesy and customer priority.

If you’re seeking real service, responsible customer care, and dignity, skip Wellness Forever entirely. This medical shop has lost a customer for good, and I strongly advise others to be wary of their so-called “professionalism”, which is just a front for bad service and disrespectful behavior.

featured_reviews.review_text: Not sure what is slower, their service or tech support. Highly recommend ordering a painkiller to cope with their delayed service and lack of communication skills.

featured_reviews.name: Girish Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text: Very bad service , In morning 7 they told will send u medicne by 12 then told by 4 then 6 now it's tommorow . Our fault also that we not buy from outside also

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Ferreira
featured_reviews.review_text: Pathetic service. The staff have no sense of urgency. I went to collect my father’s medication and they took a good 45 minutes to assemble the items together (I was the only customer), only to realise we were short of a few items (this is after them confirming all the items are with them, a day prior). Delivery service does not extend to my address and hence I went to pick up the medication. They assured me the rest of the medicines would be ready by the same evening and they would call me. It’s the next day and yet no call. What a waste of time. Such a disappointment for a well known chain.

featured_reviews.name: Arshiya Qureshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Never came across a medical store who's more concerned in stocking flavours of candies than pay attention to medicine inventory. Least attentive, complacent staff, no intent to service, will not leave their seats. No responsibility for restocking, extremely low availability of common medicines and a very lethargic staff.

featured_reviews.review_text: I got very good service, I was not able to get medicine anywhere else, you arranged it for me, thanks wellness

featured_reviews.name: Warren DSouza
featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Subham Soni
featured_reviews.review_text: I placed an order 2 hours ago but it hasn't been delivered yet. I'm disappointed that I haven't received any updates or notifications about the delay. The reason given for the delay (no delivery boy available) doesn't seem valid. Please look into this and provide a timely update on my order status. Looking forward to a prompt resolution.

featured_reviews.name: Jane Ruisado
featured_reviews.review_text: The new staff is horrible, the older staff members were great. I'm a customer of this specific outlet since it opened (look up my name in your system) in mith chowki and had a horrible experience today. I sent swiggy genie to pick up my medicine and asked the counter staff about it and he was not discreet about it at all. If so I would have told swiggy what i wanted. Then the staff refuses to give me the OTC medication saying docs prescription is required and go to the doctor. I had to speak to the manager (probably the older staff, more sensible) who sent my medication. Teach your staff to treat customers well.
